description: This Java class functions as a REST controller managing authentication endpoints, including login and password encoding, within a billing software application.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller providing authentication-related endpoints, including login and password encoding.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, generates JWT token, and returns an AuthResponse containing email, token, and role.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication of email and password, throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: encodePassword
methods.description: Encodes a password provided in the request body using the PasswordEncoder.
